title: Unfinished enrollment nudge
description: Nudge prospects who started but did not finish enrollment. Re-engagement WhatsApp template for schools. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Mention the exact course they started. Reach out within 48 hours of drop-off.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, you started enrolling in *{{course}}* but didn't finish. Your spot is still reserved until {{date}}, and we're here if you have questions.
